headline: Tanzania Prepares Announcement of Major Natural Gas Discovery in Mtwara
summary: Tanzanian Energy Minister Juma Homera began a tour of Mtwara to formally announce a major natural gas discovery intended to stimulate regional and national economic transformation.
why: East Africa holds significant offshore and onshore gas reserves. New discoveries support regional industrialisation and long-term liquefied natural gas export infrastructure.

impacts.name: Tanzania
impacts.why: Confirmed domestic natural gas discoveries boost sovereign energy reserves and attract energy sector investment.
